mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_api_key ( id, merchant_id, key_hash, status, created_at, revoked_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{merchantId}, #{keyHash}, #{status}, clock_timestamp(), #{revokedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, key_hash, status, created_at, revoked_at FROM merchant_api_key WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_api_key SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
